doc.title: Math.RandomGenerator Class
doc.para: randomize The randomize method initializes the random number generator. The arguments are the same as those passed to the constructor.
random The random method returns a real random number greater than or equal to 0 and less than 1.0.
random32 The random32 method returns an integer random value greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 4,294,967,295 (0xffffffff or less).
random63 The random63 method returns an integer random value greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 9,223,372,036,854,775,807 (0x7fffffffffffffff or less).
random64 The random64 method returns an integer random value greater than or equal to -9,223,372,036,854,775,808 and less than or equal to 9,223,372,036,854,775,807.

serialize The serialize method returns a dictionary array object containing the current state. Passing this dictionary array object to the constructor or the randomize method reproduces the current state.
